# Treatment Options

When it comes to your pet’s health, having a variety of options is important for selecting a treatment plan that fits your individual circumstances best.

Call Now

ImageImage

## Know Your Options

Acupuncture Surprisingly for those who are unfamiliar with this treatment, the insertion of these very fine needles can help produce pain reduction, improved healing, and other health benefits. Endoscopy With specialized video equipment, we can look at certain parts of your pet’s internal systems like the throat, stomach, and intestines to visualize what is going on inside without having to surgically open up your pet’s body. Hydrotherapy One of our rehabilitation therapies, hydrotherapy includes the use of our underwater treadmill which can provide many benefits including quicker recovery, improved range of motion, and muscle strengthening.

Laser Therapy Unlike the hot lasers that are used for cutting, these cool lasers do not pierce the skin and help stimulate the activities of cells and tissues to improve recovery. Minimally Invasive Surgery There are many surgical procedures that can now be performed using much smaller incisions and advanced surgical tools to reduce the collateral damage of surgery and shorten recovery time. Pain Management We have a number of tools and techniques for helping to manage your pet’s pain, providing a much better quality of life.

## How To Save Money at Pet Check-Up LLC

#### Pet Insurance

Image: Veterinarian holding puppy

Like all veterinarians, Pet Check-Up LLC accepts pet insurance for unexpected accidents & illnesses. Find the best pet insurance in Texas. Important: because pet insurance will not cover pre-existing conditions, it's important to get your pet insured while they're still healthy.

Get Pet Insurance

#### Wellness Plans

Image: Calendar

In addition to insuring against accidents & illnesses, some insurance providers offer routing care add-ons, or "wellness plans" that help you afford the cost of your pets routine health expenses.

Consider Wellness Plans

#### Treatment Financing

Image: Financing Solutions

Having pet insurance is the best way to avoid unexpected medical costs, but if you have expenses for existing medical conditions and need help financing the cost, ask your vet if they accept financing solutions like CareCredit and Scratchpay. These payment options will help you space out your payments over time, so you can afford any large unexpected upfront costs.

## História

Petlove é uma loja eletrônica de venda de produtos para animais domésticos, fundada pelo médico veterinário Márcio Waldman em 1999 com nome de PetSuperMarket, foi a primeira loja virtual para pets do país, nos primeiros 6 meses não vendeu nenhum produto.

Em 2025 chegou a lucrar R$2.45 bilhões em receita impulsionada pela expansão física, o fortalecimento dos planos de saúde para pets e a consolidação do Clube Petlove, seu programa de assinatura. Em 2022 o Grupo Globo se tornou acionista da Petlove.
## Fusão

Em 2020 foi fundida a DogHero, uma outra empresa do mesmo ramo.
## Serviços

A Petlove se destaca por oferecer um comércio virtual para produtos para pets, além de ter oferecer planos de saúde e auxiliar com os cuidados de saúde para os pets.
